name: KineticPosterTypography
description: A full-screen Swiss kinetic typography hero section and poster block featuring a staggered slit-masked vertical word swap, dramatic 3D perspective X-axis cylinder flip, and effortless zero-config customization.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: A Swiss-inspired kinetic typography poster featuring a staggered vertical letter-column swap and a 3D perspective X-axis cylinder flip driven by zero-rerender 60fps requestAnimationFrame motion.

checkpoints.name: v2: Matched pure black Swiss poster colors, full-bleed bottom-anchored section proportions, Helvetica Neue regular weight typography, slit-masked Phase 2 upward wipe + unclipped drop, dramatic 420px 3D perspective Phase 4 flip, and camera zoom breath.
checkpoints.description: Matched pure black Swiss poster colors, full-bleed bottom-anchored section proportions, Helvetica Neue regular weight typography, slit-masked Phase 2 upward wipe + unclipped drop, dramatic 420px 3D perspective Phase 4 flip, and camera zoom breath.

checkpoints.name: v3: Upgraded to full-screen Hero section/block by default (layout='section' with 100dvh edge-to-edge canvas and fluid min(92vw,88dvh,760px) Swiss stage), added compact layout='poster' option, flexible string[] leftMeta/rightMeta props, and exposed layout + subtitle controls for effortless drop-in reuse.
